source_commit_note: The original 31 CIFAR and all_captions measurements retain their three historical source commits. The seven prior official_first_caption records retain their two recorded commits and dirty flags; the audit found one clean and six dirty worktrees. The run-status evidence attributes the dirty state to generated raw results being untracked during later runs; the exact uncommitted file set is unrecoverable. Seven clean replacements were executed from frozen source commit 9d170b6071eecd75d7100ca70092d44d86650f01, staged outside the tracked tree, and published without rewriting prior raw results.
